name: Ckeditor 5 Inline Styles
description: CKEditor 5 plugin plus a text-format filter that stores a free-text inline-style string on an embedded Drupal media element and renders it as the element's style attribute.
project_description: The CKEditor 5 Inline Styles module adds a "Media Inline Styles" toolbar button to CKEditor 5 that lets an editor attach a free-text inline-style string to an embedded Drupal media (drupal-media) element. The typed value is stored on the element as a data-inline-style attribute in the editor model, and a companion text-format filter (Inline Style, id filter_inline_style) copies that stored value onto the rendered element's style attribute at display time. It works only with media embeds (Media Library / drupal-media); there is no admin settings form, no config schema, and no permissions of its own. Installed here as a 1.x-dev checkout (git 1.x branch, commit de56989, 2024-04-12). This module is maintained by developers at Digital Polygon.
